title: Early Days
description: In his younger years, Steve worked at a video game company and traveled across India. He spent this time looking for a deeper purpose in life. These experiences taught him that the best things are simple and clear, an idea that would guide everything he did later on.

title: Starting Apple
description: When he came back home, Steve teamed up with his friend Steve Wozniak in a small family garage. They started Apple because they wanted to make computers easy for everyone to use. What began as a small project in a garage soon started to change the way the whole world lived.

title: The Macintosh
description: A few years later, Steve introduced the Macintosh. It was a special computer because it had a screen that was easy for anyone to understand. With a famous TV commercial that everyone talked about, he showed the world that technology could be helpful and friendly instead of scary.

title: A New Path
description: Even though things were going well, Steve had a disagreement with the leaders at Apple and had to leave the company he started. It was a very sad time for him, but he did not give up. He started a new business and helped a group of creative artists build what would become Pixar.

title: Coming Home
description: After being away for twelve years, Steve returned to Apple when the company was struggling. He took charge and reminded people that Apple was a place for dreamers. This was the start of a great time for the company that showed his ideas were still exactly what the world was waiting for.

title: The iPod
description: As Apple grew strong again, Steve found a new way to help people enjoy life. He created the iPod, a tiny device that could hold a thousand songs. It changed the way we listen to music and showed that great technology could fit right in your pocket.

title: The iPhone
description: Steve showed the world the iPhone, a device that changed how we use phones and the internet. It was a phone, a music player, and a way to browse the web all in one. This invention changed the way we connect with each other every single day.

title: His Legacy
description: Steve Jobs passed away, but his ideas live on. He left behind a world that is more connected and creative because of his work. He always encouraged people to stay hungry for new ideas and to follow their hearts, a message that still inspires people today.
